title: Heavenfall: Celestial Ruin
answer: Celestial Ruin marks a target for sixty seconds with a 100-block-diameter pulsing column. The event persists even when every player leaves. Near impact, its 19×19 chunk region is loaded progressively, then Heavenfall flashes white, rings the ears, releases up to 50,000 custom damage with quadratic falloff across 6,000 blocks, excavates a 120-block-radius crater and traces 96 loaded-chunk fire scars. Coordinates survive restart and exact tickets are removed afterward. It is a containment spell, not a safe combat toy.
